conviction_note: The only sourced finding for the window is supply: an effective H.C. Wainwright ATM with about $6.0m of stated room, used before, at a going-concern issuer that can sell into any Monday bounce without filing anything. It is sized at -1.0 and kept small because the name's own 76 comparable falls have a median of -0.56 with fat right tails (+43.7%, +9.65%, +5.87%), the cross-section prior for this band is +0.5, and a 33% ATR swamps a one-point call; there is no repricing mechanism, so leg 1 is 0.
bar: The name's own reaction function: 76 falls of 6.36% or more over 3 years, median next close -0.56%, up-rate 40.8%, median absolute move 4.06% (sealed baseline, yahoo chart v8 bars). Supply capacity comes from the 424B5 of 2026-05-26 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1621221/000164033426000966/artl_424b5.htm) and the 10-Q of 2026-08-12 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1621221/000164033426001323/artl_10q.htm). There is no option chain.

cause.label: no_identifiable_cause
cause.what_happened: This is the second day of giving back a 206% one-day spike on 2026-09-23. That spike followed a 07:33 ET release of mouse (DIO-2) obesity data and a provisional patent on ART27.13. The stock fell 29.3% on 09-24 and a further 9.1% by 15:04 ET today (5.4% of it at the gap), on 2.8x normal dollar volume. No new filing or release was found for 09-24 or 09-25.

evidence.claim: The 2026-09-23 release: provisional patent on ART27.13 for obesity. Nonclinical four-week DIO-2 mouse data showed about 20% weight loss on monotherapy and about 40% combined with semaglutide. No financing and no dated next step were given.
The shares closed up 206% on Wednesday 09-23 after an intraday high of $12.20. They were still down 59% year to date and 97% over twelve months.
EDGAR shows no filing from this issuer after the 8-K of 2026-08-27, so no offering, 8-K or 424B was filed on 09-24 or 09-25 up to the screen.

pipeline.next_dated_event: None found inside the window. Short-interest settlement 2026-09-30 publishes about 2026-10-09. Q3 10-Q is estimated for 2026-11-11 (Zacks cadence prior only, not a company date).
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A company release before Monday's open with a dated obesity programme step (IND or clinical plan) or a strategic partner would undercut the supply read. A 424B5 or registered-direct 8-K overnight would make it much larger.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA short interest at the 2026-09-15 settlement: 22,550 shares, 1.0 days to cover, down 37.2% from 35,918 at 08-31. That is before the 09-23 spike and about eight business days lagged, so the position carried into this fall is not observable. It is too small to be squeeze fuel. Shares outstanding were about 547,774 after the 1-for-9 reverse split effective 2026-08-28 (8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1621221/000164033426001421/artl_8k.htm). No insider trades in 3 or 12 months (Nasdaq insider-trades). There is no options market, so there is no skew. Source: https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/ARTL/short-interest?assetclass=stocks

findings.finding: An open, effective H.C. Wainwright ATM can sell into any bounce during the 2026-09-28 session with no filing required. It carried about $6.0m of stated room as of 2026-08-11, and the issuer has already drawn on it. The issuer is a going concern with $4.2m of cash at 30 June against about $2.4-2.7m of quarterly burn.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The S-3 has been effective since 2026-05-19 and the ATM agreement has been live since 2026-05-26. ATM sales settle through the day at the agent's discretion and need no 8-K, so supply can print on Monday 09-28 itself. Precedent: 142,860 shares were sold by 30 June and 386,668 more by 11 August (pre-split counts). The issuer has every reason to sell into strength after a 206% spike put its value above its cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated ATM-draw event can be isolated in the baseline. The name's own comparable falls (n=76) have a median of -0.56 and an up-rate of 40.8%, with bounces capped in most cases. The -17.84% day after the 2026-07-28 drop fell inside the period when ATM sales were running (10-Q subsequent events).
findings.why_not_priced: The fall so far is a give-back of the spike, and the ATM's existence is public. What the price does not hold is that any recovery on 09-28 meets a seller with no fixed size or date. Short interest is tiny, so there is no covering demand to offset it. If the market had fully priced this, the name would trade with muted bounces. Its own history shows +5.9% and +9.7% next-day bounces after the 09-14 and 09-16 falls, so rebounds still happen.
findings.independence: The 424B5 of 2026-05-26 sets up the same $6.53m HCW ATM under the baby-shelf limit, with $5.7m already sold in the prior 12 months (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1621221/000164033426000966/artl_424b5.htm). The going-concern language is in the 10-Q. The 8-K of 2026-05-27 is the agreement itself (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1621221/000164033426000973/artl_8k.htm). All three are issuer filings, so they are not fully independent.

outside_window.finding: Going concern: the next 10-Q (company date not announced; Zacks estimates 2026-11-11) will show Q3 cash burn and ATM usage. That will reveal how much stock was sold into the 09-23 spike.

Pre-funded warrants from the March 2026 S-1 offering (3,107,407 pre-split, about 345k post-split, exercise price $0.001 pre-split) can be exercised and sold at any time. The overhang is real but carries no date.

The move is still about +97% above the 2026-09-22 pre-spike close (about $2.39, derived from baseline returns). The spike rested on four-week mouse data and a provisional patent, with no clinical obesity programme dated. A further fade is plausible, but no mechanism dates it.

baseline_tension: The supply read agrees with the high ATR (32.9%, which ranks toward continuation) and the going-concern context. It cuts against the name's own record of sharp next-day bounces after the 09-14 and 09-16 falls, and against the +0.5 cross-section prior for a -7.5 to -10 fall on under 15x volume. So the number is held at -1.0 rather than sized to the ATR.
